policies.name: manual
policies.description: Operator must explicitly approve every deploy.
policies.rationale: Safest default for production-critical hosts. Every promotion is a human decision.

policies.name: auto_latest
policies.description: Auto-deploy the newest passing commit on the assigned flake/branch.
policies.rationale: Best for dev and edge nodes that should always track HEAD.

policies.name: pinned
policies.description: Stay on a specific commit until manually changed.
policies.rationale: Holds a system at a known-good revision. Use for compliance baselines.

policies.name: cve-gated
policies.description: Block deploys that introduce any critical CVE.
policies.rationale: Catches regressions surfaced by vulnix during eval. Critical = hard block.

policies.name: business-hours
policies.description: Auto-deploy permitted only between 09:00–17:00 weekdays, US-East.
policies.rationale: Operator-coverage window. Outside hours, defer to manual.

policies.name: two-approver
policies.description: Requires sign-off from 2 distinct operators with admin role.
policies.rationale: For tier-0 systems (auth providers, secrets brokers). 4-eyes principle.

policies.name: canary-25
policies.description: Roll out to 25% of matching systems at a time, watch for 30 min, then continue.
policies.rationale: Staged rollout for the web tier. Disabled — pending observability integration.

policies.name: stig-ssh-hardening
policies.description: Anduril NixOS STIG: SSH daemon hardening — no root login, FIPS ciphers, 10-min idle timeout.

rules.message: SSH must use only FIPS-validated ciphers

policies.rationale: V-268137 (no root SSH login), V-268142 (10-min idle timeout), V-268089 (FIPS-approved remote-access encryption). SRG-OS-000109 / 000163 / 000033.

policies.name: stig-audit-daemon
policies.description: Anduril NixOS STIG: audit daemon enabled with the firewall to enforce host logging and ingress control.

rules.message: Audit rules must be configured in configuration.nix

policies.rationale: V-268080 (enable the audit daemon), V-268078 (enable the built-in firewall). SRG-OS-000004 / 000298.

policies.name: stig-consent-banner
policies.description: Anduril NixOS STIG: DoD Notice and Consent banner on all command-line logon paths.

rules.message: /etc/issue must contain the DoD/USG consent banner

policies.rationale: V-268082 (display the Standard Mandatory DOD Notice and Consent Banner). SRG-OS-000023-GPOS-00006.

evidence.note: Must contain the DoD/USG consent banner verbatim

policies.name: stig-fips-crypto
policies.description: Anduril NixOS STIG: FIPS-validated cryptography enabled and data-at-rest encrypted.

rules.message: Data partitions must be LUKS-encrypted via boot.initrd.luks.devices

policies.rationale: V-268168 (FIPS-validated cryptography), V-268144 (protect information at rest). SRG-OS-000478 / 000185.

evidence.note: Agent attests security.enableFIPSMode = true at activation

policies.name: stig-usbguard
policies.description: Anduril NixOS STIG: USBguard enabled with an allow-list policy to control peripheral access.

rules.message: USBguard must define an allow-list policy

policies.rationale: V-268139 (enable USBguard). SRG-OS-000114 — controls unauthorized peripheral connections.

policies.name: stig-password-policy
policies.description: Anduril NixOS STIG: enforce 15-character minimum password length and encrypted password storage.

rules.message: Passwords must be stored using yescrypt or sha512

policies.rationale: V-268134 (15-char minimum length), V-268130 (encrypted password storage). SRG-OS-000078 / 000112.
